definitions.explanation: describes a person who is focused on their inner world and who often prefers solitary activities or small group interactions

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内向的|ないこうてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{内向的|ないこうてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人数|おおにんずう}→大人数：22750_ooninzuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Introverted people tend to get tired at large gatherings.

examples.japanese: {内向的|ないこうてき}だ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{人付|ひとづ}き{合|あ}い→人付き合い：15516_hitozukiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Being introverted doesn't necessarily mean you're bad at socializing.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{内向|ないこう} (introversion) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-ic, -al)

USAGE:
A psychology-flavored word for how a person directs attention and recharges: {内向的|ないこうてき} people recharge through solitude and reflection. It is not the same as shyness (⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧): many introverts are socially skilled but prefer small groups.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外向的|がいこうてき}→外向的：08459_gaikouteki⟧ (extroverted): the direct opposite
- ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧: shy, timid (a matter of nervousness, not preference)

FORMS:
{内向的|ないこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - in an introverted manner
